paragraphs: Infax builds digital information display systems and the analytics that go with them. The facilities it serves are courts, airports, public venues, mass transit and jails.

The company takes a project from design through deployment and supplies both the software and the hardware. It also sells a data analysis service meant to surface trends and peak hours and inform staffing. A recent announcement on the site covers the release of Engage 4.5.

The range of facilities runs from the busiest airports to the smallest courthouses. Listed projects include the Dallas County Court System. The San Bernardino Justice Center is another. The site puts the company's experience at 50 years. Infax describes itself as one of the few U.S.-based companies in the business that is still family owned.
